# HR Industry Opportunities

| Opportunity | Why it is attractive | Industry capability requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Advanced manufacturing | Large workforces, sites, shifts and payroll-linked attendance produce measurable operational pain. | Support site structures, bulk onboarding, shift rules, overtime and payroll reconciliation. |
| Chain retail and catering | Store dispersion, part-time staff and high turnover make mobile, repeatable HR operations valuable. | Support store templates, mobile attendance, rapid join/leave and headquarters reporting. |
| Logistics and warehousing | Branches, field work and seasonal peaks require flexible attendance and employee operations. | Support network/site models, field attendance, exception workflows and payroll closure. |
| Hotel and tourism groups | 24/7 operations and seasonal demand create scheduling and staffing volatility. | Support property templates, scheduling, onboarding and cross-property transfers. |
| Asia-Pacific growth companies | Regional employers need local rules, language, currency and data controls without a single-country assumption. | Support country configuration, regional data governance and staged implementation. |
